AS

	-- IMPORTANT:

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @TipoInventarioFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		TipoInventario_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @TipoInventarioFilter (TipoInventario_Id)
		SELECT 
			[TipoInventario].Id
		FROM [dbo].[TipoInventario]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[TipoInventario].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @TipoInventarioFilter (TipoInventario_Id)
		SELECT 
			[TipoInventario].Id
		FROM [dbo].[TipoInventario]
		WHERE
			 [TipoInventario].[Activo] = 1

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[TipoInventario].[Id],
		[TipoInventario].[Nombre],
		[TipoInventario].[Activo],
		[TipoInventario].[FechaDesactivacion],
		[TipoInventario].[DesactivadoPor],
		[TipoInventario].[FechaCreacion],
		[TipoInventario].[CreadoPor],
		[TipoInventario].[FechaModificacion],
		[TipoInventario].[ModificadoPor]
	FROM @TipoInventarioFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[TipoInventario] 
			ON [TipoInventario].[Id] = filter.[TipoInventario_Id] 
			


END
